patch.summary: Is Clearbit worth it? Clearbit is HubSpot’s B2B data enrichment product, now part of HubSpot Breeze Intelligence — used to enrich CRM records and power inbound/account intelligence, monetized via HubSpot credits rather than a standalone classic SI database.. Strong when HubSpot customers that need CRM and inbound enrichment via Breeze Intelligence / Clearbit. Weak when Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric.

blocks.body: Clearbit earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Clearbit: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact data and HubSpot customers that need CRM and inbound enrichment via Breeze Intelligence / Clearbit holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: HubSpot, Salesforce, Segment.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Enrichment Credits (HubSpot).

sections.heading: Who Clearbit is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Clearbit / Breeze Intelligence when HubSpot-native enrichment is the job and you already (or will) buy HubSpot credits..

Avoid if: Compare Clay for multi-provider waterfalls, Lusha for SMB enrichment+contact data, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Apollo for prospecting+sequences..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Clay on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Clearbit price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
